steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Eunectes! Eunectes!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Go get them, Eunectes!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Great Chief! Great Chief!

steps.name: Archosauria D
steps.text: Eunectes, marry me!

steps.name: Archosauria Warrior
steps.text: ...Well, look who showed up. Eunectes.

steps.name: Archosauria Warrior
steps.text: I thought you were going to hide in that little rainforest of yours, too scared to show up.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: And you're too afraid to come visit?

steps.name: Archosauria Warrior
steps.text: Hmph, you're all cowards for holing up in your rainforest!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: We'll find out right now if that really makes me a coward.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, even with all those weird gadgets, Zumama hasn't changed one bit.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, right. Doctor, I never told you about her, did I?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That girl in the arena is Zumama. We aren't from the same tribe, but we lived pretty close to each other. Plus, we're about the same age, so you could say we grew up together.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: She doesn't talk much, but she handles herself in a fight.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: She started acting kinda weird at some point, though. I mean, she was still pretty tough, but she was always tinkering with stuff all by herself.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Her tribe moved away not long after that, and we didn't see each other much anymore.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Word is she's as strong as ever, but she came down with some weird disease and started talking to herself.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I looked into the symptoms back at Rhodes Island. It sounded like some kind of mental illness, but she looks pretty normal to me right now.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I was half-expecting her to come to the last ceremony, but too bad she never did.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And now she's here, calling herself Eunectes? Who would've thought? Anyway, now that she's here, you see that guy up there? Probably done for.

steps.name: Archosauria Warrior
steps.text: Gahh!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah, I knew it! She did get stronger! Now I really want to fight her!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Zumama is strong. There's no doubt about that, but...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmm? Who are those guys over there...?

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: Eunectes, we'll challenge you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: I'm the leader of the Raging Flames, Uda!

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: I'm the leader of the Scars, Aruna!

steps.name: Uda & Aruna
steps.text: Alright, you lot! Get her!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Are all of you ganging up on me?

steps.name: Uda
steps.text: Yeah, that's right. Our tribes' got a little, uh... what do you call those again?

steps.name: Aruna
steps.text: It's a pact, you dimwit!

steps.name: Uda
steps.text: That's right, a pact!

steps.name: Aruna
steps.text: If you want the throne, you'll have to go through us!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I wasn't expecting it to be a walk in the park. But I didn't know you could be so unified.

steps.name: Uda
steps.text: What's that got to do with you?

steps.name: Aruna
steps.text: Hmph, and a Great Chief who's always tinkering with widgets? You can bet I have a problem with that!

options: You're allowed to bring people with you to the ceremony?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hm? Oh, yes, that's allowed.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Looks like the Doctor thought this was some kind of martial arts tournament.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hm? Wouldn't that take a while?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Most folks fight one-on-one out of pride, but the only rule the ceremony's got is that you can do whatever it takes to win, and whoever that ends up winning will become the Great Chief.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Obviously, bringing your lackeys with you is the best way to get that done.

options: Sounds like I could become the Great Chief.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, you aren't thinking about joining in, are you? Give up that dream right now.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ah, Doctor, whatever you're thinking, I can tell you're up to no good.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hahaha, Doctor. I hate to break it to you, but you don't have what it takes.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I did say there's no rules, but it's not what you're thinking.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: The folks here are pretty simple. The only thing they can think of is to bring lots of people with 'em, no matter what it is they're trying to do.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: No one here would even think of pulling any dirty tricks.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Honestly, even after my years with Rhodes Island, I've still got no idea how to go do that kinda stuff.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yep. Besides, fighting as a group has its own risks.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha, that's right. They might just start infighting afterwards. Happens all the time.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But on the flipside, that does mean you can do whatever it takes for you to win, and you're free to try.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But I'm sure you're just gonna get yourself beaten up.

options: You really think I'm that bad?
Sounds like people here lead a simple life.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hahaha, I'm just putting it the way it is.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha, it's not often I see you roll your eyes like that.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, it wasn't till I left that I found out just how simple things were back home.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I used to think everyone everywhere would be just like us.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, Doctor, I do think you'd be able to pull it off and still keep it under wraps, but there's one thing that separates you from the rest of them. Do you know what that is?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Exactly! Look how weak you are!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Come on, Doctor. Don't pout.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You could say that. I mean, you have any idea how weak you look?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Anyway, I'll get right down to it. If you want to be the Great Chief, there's actually just one requirement that you've gotta meet.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You just gotta be strong enough to put up a good fight.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Right, Tomimi?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hm? Yeah, yeah!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: This is strange, though. From what I remember, those two aren't exactly best friends. I didn't expect to see them working together.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hmm, they probably became friends after you left.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, could be.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmm? Tomimi, didn't you say Zumama is her tribe's leader? Where are her people?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh? Now that you mention it, I don't see a lot of people from her tribe.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Look, the ones dressed differently over there should be from her tribe.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, they all look pretty well-equipped, but that's not a whole lot of them.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Heh, she's following in my footsteps and trying to take them all down by herself, isn't she? Now that's what I'm talking about!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That reminds me. Tomimi, I thought you were going to fight.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Eh? Yeah, but I'm in no rush.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Zumama's tough. The Scars won't stand a chance against her, so I'll join in after she wears herself out on them.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hehe, you've gotten smarter, Tomimi.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ehehe, I'm pretty serious about becoming the Great Chief. Besides...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Besides what?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, let's talk later. They're about to get started!
